reviews.body: Thanks, @cmccabe. Can you add a brief description on why we need this? I thought we would wait to initialize publishers until MetadataLoader had caught up on the log. Do we have a race condition between catching up on the log and handling the leader change event?

review_comments.body: Should we call this "initialLeaderAndEpochAccessor" since we only read from it during startup? Otherwise it might be confusing that we have this supplier, but update the `currentLeaderAndEpoch` in a different way
